constraints.name: currencies_rounding_mode_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (rounding_mode::text = ANY (ARRAY['DOWN'::character varying, 'UP'::character varying, 'HALF_UP'::character varying, 'HALF_EVEN'::character varying]::text[]))

constraints.name: email_verification_consumed_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (consumed_at IS NULL OR consumed_at >= created_at)

constraints.name: email_verification_tokens_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES mymoneymap.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: fx_conversion_snapshots_source_currency_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (source_currency) REFERENCES mymoneymap.currencies(code) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: fx_conversion_snapshots_source_quote_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (source_quote_id) REFERENCES mymoneymap.fx_quotes(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: fx_conversion_snapshots_target_currency_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (target_currency) REFERENCES mymoneymap.currencies(code) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: fx_conversion_snapshots_target_quote_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (target_quote_id) REFERENCES mymoneymap.fx_quotes(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: fx_snapshots_entry_owner_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (entry_id, user_id) REFERENCES mymoneymap.journal_entries(id, user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: fx_snapshots_result_shape_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (status::text = 'unavailable'::text AND converted_amount IS NULL AND source_rate IS NULL AND target_rate IS NULL AND conversion_rate IS NULL AND provider IS NULL AND rate_at IS NULL AND fetched_at IS NULL OR (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['available'::character varying, 'stale'::character varying]::text[])) AND converted_amount IS NOT NULL AND source_rate IS NOT NULL AND target_rate IS NOT NULL AND conversion_rate IS NOT NULL AND provider IS NOT NULL AND rate_at IS NOT NULL AND fetched_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: fx_snapshots_rounding_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (rounding_mode::text = ANY (ARRAY['DOWN'::character varying, 'UP'::character varying, 'HALF_UP'::character varying, 'HALF_EVEN'::character varying]::text[]))

constraints.name: fx_quotes_base_code_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (base_code) REFERENCES mymoneymap.currencies(code) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: fx_quotes_observation_time_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (observed_at <= fetched_at AND observed_on = (observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)::date)

constraints.name: fx_quotes_quote_code_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (quote_code) REFERENCES mymoneymap.currencies(code) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: idempotency_keys_completion_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (status::text = 'in_progress'::text AND response IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL OR status::text = 'completed'::text AND response IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(response) = 'object'::text AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: journal_entries_actor_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (actor_user_id) REFERENCES mymoneymap.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: journal_entries_category_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (category_id IS NULL OR (economic_type::text = ANY (ARRAY['external_income'::character varying, 'external_expense'::character varying, 'fee'::character varying]::text[])))

constraints.name: journal_entries_correction_link_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (NOT (reverses_entry_id IS NOT NULL AND replaces_entry_id IS NOT NULL))

constraints.name: journal_entries_economic_type_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (economic_type::text = ANY (ARRAY['external_income'::character varying, 'external_expense'::character varying, 'internal_transfer'::character varying, 'adjustment'::character varying, 'fee'::character varying, 'interest'::character varying, 'dividend'::character varying, 'loan_repayment'::character varying, 'trade_cash'::character varying]::text[]))

constraints.name: journal_entries_note_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (note IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(note::text)) >= 1 AND char_length(btrim(note::text)) <= 1000)

constraints.name: journal_entries_replaces_owner_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (replaces_entry_id, user_id) REFERENCES mymoneymap.journal_entries(id, user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: journal_entries_reverses_owner_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (reverses_entry_id, user_id) REFERENCES mymoneymap.journal_entries(id, user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: journal_entries_source_module_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (source_module::text = ANY (ARRAY['manual'::character varying, 'scheduling'::character varying, 'goals'::character varying, 'emergency_fund'::character varying, 'loans'::character varying, 'investments'::character varying, 'securities'::character varying, 'migration'::character varying]::text[]))

constraints.name: journal_entries_source_reference_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (source_module::text = 'manual'::text OR source_reference_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: journal_entries_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES mymoneymap.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: journal_legs_account_owner_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (account_id, user_id) REFERENCES mymoneymap.ledger_accounts(id, user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: journal_legs_currency_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (currency) REFERENCES mymoneymap.currencies(code) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: journal_legs_entry_owner_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (entry_id, user_id) REFERENCES mymoneymap.journal_entries(id, user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: ledger_accounts_kind_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (kind::text = ANY (ARRAY['cash'::character varying, 'goal'::character varying, 'emergency_reserve'::character varying, 'investment'::character varying, 'loan_liability'::character varying, 'securities_cash'::character varying, 'securities_holding'::character varying]::text[]))

constraints.name: ledger_accounts_module_reference_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (kind::text = 'cash'::text AND module_reference_id IS NULL OR kind::text <> 'cash'::text AND module_reference_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: ledger_accounts_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES mymoneymap.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: login_audit_events_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES mymoneymap.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: passkeys_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES mymoneymap.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: user_currencies_code_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (code) REFERENCES mymoneymap.currencies(code) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: user_currencies_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES mymoneymap.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: users_theme_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (theme::text = ANY (ARRAY['polar-quartz'::character varying, 'verdant-horizon'::character varying, 'celestial-tide'::character varying, 'blush-nocturne'::character varying, 'ember-vanguard'::character varying, 'lilac-eclipse'::character varying, 'solaris-bloom'::character varying, 'dune-mirage'::character varying]::text[]))
